result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.add_gnm_graph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add an Erdős-Rényi G(n,m) random graph to the current graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L2422-L2486){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.add_gnm_graph(n, m, directed=None, seed=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Creates a graph with `n` nodes and exactly m randomly placed edges. This model is useful for generating random graphs with a fixed number of edges. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [n]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of nodes to add. [m]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of edges to create. [directed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[bool]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : If provided and differs from graph's directed setting, creates temporary graph with specified directedness. [seed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Random seed for reproducibility. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Generate a random graph: ::: {#52ad170c .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_gnm_graph(n=50, m=100, seed=23) ) # Returns 50 graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 50 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#e1e785b2 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns 100 graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 100 ``` ::: :::
